Over the years, both my children and I have been misdiagnosed multiple times, leading to serious consequences for our health.

One particularly alarming experience involved a senior GP dismissing my concerns about perimenopausal symptoms. Despite expressing that I suspected I was entering perimenopause, she laughed and told me I was too young, completely disregarding that perimenopause can occur at various ages. She prescribed me the wrong medication, which worsened my symptoms to the point that I almost ended up in a mental health crisis.When I reported this to her, she casually offered antidepressants and didn’t even arrange a follow-up to check on my well-being. I had to take matters into my own hands and consult a private GP, who immediately confirmed I was perimenopausal and prescribed HRT. My symptoms improved almost instantly.

This kind of negligence is unacceptable, and I have completely lost trust in this practice.
I’ve even witnessed doctors Googling information in front of me, which makes me wonder—why bother going to the GP if I can just look things up myself? It seems they are only useful for minor issues like colds or flu. I would not recommend trusting them with anything beyond that.",null,[0,191]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMyNHMtTk13EAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x7a88711442297b92!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIC24s-NMw%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMyNHMtTk13EAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUMyNHMtTk13Ei0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQzI0cy1Oc3dFEhJDZ3NJdWVfWnR3WVEyT1dsSmcaLQoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lDMjRzLU5jdxITQ2d3SWdLUHNrZ1lRdVBhZW9BRSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEZJ7KUIUcYh6KhJDZ3NJdWVfWnR3WVEyT1dsSmc&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjK8oLr_q2TAxXaEWMBHSO1BFgQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjK8oLr_q2TAxXaEWMBHSO1BFgQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSek5PVUVaVlNGOWZSV2hEWTJJMFNHSlZUVWxyZDB4c1drczBWVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEo0YjBOaVl6QTRWbEZqV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR6dll5WHRBRRAB",["0x0:0x7a88711442297b92",null,1718136156534536,1718136156534536,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103891386675154184830/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Nuland","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK23fUB6UQgggx7ebNOfPYaqfXL65gtq5szjRgqch_CyBOTnw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103891386675154184830?hl=en"],"103891386675154184830",null,37,3,null,[1,5,1],7,["Local Guide · 37 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjK8oLr_q2TAxXaEWMBHSO1BFgQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Receptionists massive rude and unhelpful, it's like they go out their way to not help you.
